I work in a Govt. Arms and Ammunition manufacturing unit under Ministry of Defence. A system called 'Outgoing Circular' is effective in our organisation in which a person or a group of people apply for outgoing facility for events like Diwali, Ganesh jayanti, Ambedkar jayanti, Ramdhan any many more events where they go out of the factory getting one time punching exemption and not to return for the day under the pretext of doing welfare work . In turn they get their Overtime booked for the whole day and get the pay accodingly. This type of facility is also availed by our muslim brethren in the holy month of Ramadhan. I want to ask whether taking this facility is jayaz as the overtime pay is granted if the person works in the factory beyond 8 hours of normal working. Please reply my query. May Allah give us all hidayat. 2664 views Q. As Salam-o Alaikum My aunt has an eight-year-old daughter who is suffering from severe Asthma. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 8452 Country: India Title: I have completed hotel management & joined a five star hotel as a chef my job is of making pizzas some of the pizzas have pork(pig)as toppings hich i have to cut & cook is this job permissible pleasee reply at the earliest allah hafiz. Question: I have completed hotel management & joined a five star hotel as a chef my job is of making pizzas some of the pizzas have pork(pig)as toppings hich i have to cut & cook is this job permissible pleasee reply at the earliest allah hafiz. Answer ID: 8452 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2007/1593=H/1429) It is unlawful to slaughter pig and cook its pork. Also, this job is not allowed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
